note: Trigger-routing suite, minted alongside artifact-styling-rules (closes #650, lld-0020). Positives are consult-only asks from the record's own real sessions ('colors are a bit nuts', 'why sharp corners', 'diagrams look off-theme') one per axis (platform, token architecture, type/layout, mermaid, shells) plus adjacent-phrasing repeats. Negatives fence the four siblings this capability overlaps trigger vocabulary with: make-artifact (the build ask itself), make-design-system (authoring/grading the token SOURCE), dataviz (chart/graph color and mark-spec choices), break-down-layout (non-artifact screen layout critique).
